Appliance Error Code Guide / 4C

4CSamsung

Samsung dishwasher 4C

Context

Water supply does not meet the required conditions.

Checks

  1. Check whether water is also unavailable at the kitchen faucet.
  2. Without moving the appliance, look for a pinched inlet hose or closed supply valve.

Next action

If supply is available but the code persists, report model and observations to official manufacturer service. Leave valve/filter disassembly to service.

Sources

  • Samsung US — dishwasher error codes ↗

Checked on 2026-10-27

Scope

Samsung US dishwashers with digital code displays covered by this guide; do not translate into blinking-light patterns.
